maturity.basis: Engineering estimate, not a measured benchmark.
maturity.changeReason: Fresh repeat execution of an already-qualified build lane is not a new scope transition or complete feedback round.

build.canonicalDefinition: SHA256 of compact UTF-8 JSON of sorted [name, type-hex, size, content-SHA256, linkname] tuples; content is empty for non-regular members; all members including directories count.

observations: The simulator commandline-tools directory was not the application-build SDK. The actual SDK path was recovered from recorded project configuration and its executable versions were verified.

The initial compound dependency command (exec-00000000000001a9) reported dependency exit 0 but outer operation exit 1. That ambiguous operation was not used as successful execution proof; a distinct direct executable capture succeeded.
Build warnings remain in complete captured stdout/stderr strings; packaging success does not imply device/API compatibility.
limitations: Operator-driven execution, not an automated gap-plan operation dispatcher or construction Agent run.
No new semantic scope closure, TableGit transaction, calibrated case execution, emulator run or feedback promotion.
The member comparison algorithm includes directories and differs from historical regular-file-only counts; historical canonical hashes are not directly comparable.
Captured command JSON and host readback are inspectable evidence, not an independent cryptographic host attestation.

The initial ambiguous compound operation's handle later returned not_found; that readback is retained separately and does not reconstruct its original result. Successful direct dependency and both build captures were preserved immediately.
Model configuration was not located in the inspected credential/startup locations; this does not prove it is absent everywhere.
